description: A formal dining room with warm, understated European elegance. The walls are a soft greige plaster, and two tall multi-pane windows flanking the back wall are dressed in layered window treatments — sheer white inner panels glowing with diffuse daylight, and long sand-toned drape panels pooling gently at each side. The floor is a richly patterned chevron herringbone parquet in medium-toned wood, partially covered by a large traditional area rug in warm rust and ivory tones with floral motifs. A substantial rectangular dining table in warm honey-toned oak occupies the center of the room, set with white ceramic plates, silver flatware, and a clear glass vase holding a delicate arrangement of trailing green-leafed branches as a low centerpiece. Six dining chairs surround the table — each with a rounded, softly upholstered cream bouclé shell and dark walnut legs, the silhouette clean and mid-century-adjacent. Warm diffuse light bathes the room from the windows and from two warm glowing sources hanging above the table, casting gentle downward illumination onto the tabletop. The ceiling above is plain plaster with a subtle cove cornice. Camera is at seated-to-standing eye-level, centered symmetrically on the table and back wall, shot with a normal lens giving a composed, elegant framing of the full dining arrangement.
